prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Korean woman — the personification of Gyeongju — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Gyeongju as her world knows it — a golden capital of an eastern myth-world in a basin of low green hills: pale granite and dark pine wood, red-lacquered pillars under gently upswept dark-tiled eaves, thin hammered gold hung with trembling gold spangles, curved green jade, silk and lacquered wood, lantern-light and drifting spirit lights, cherry blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the star tower, the great grass mounds or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a harbour-front eating house of a little fishing town on the eastern sea, a wooden plate of fresh sliced fish, painted fishing boats moored below and the sea turning gold.
Around her, as her world makes them: a wooden plate of fresh sliced raw fish with lettuce leaves, garlic and a little dish of red chili paste; a small glazed porcelain wine cup; earthenware bowls on a wooden tray.
Season: autumn — clear, mild days, the low hills turning red and gold, and the October festival of the ancient capital with folk games, music and dance.
Time of day: midday — bright, even daylight; hard bright sun, crisp short shadows on the ground.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a knotted sarong skirt with a matching halter crop top and a shell anklet — in warm earth tones such as camel, olive, terracotta, chocolate or burgundy; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a translucent chiffon overlayer and a high-waisted line; right now — the slit or wrap of her skirt has fallen open along one thigh with her movement, baring that leg up to the hip line; the fabric stays in place, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; back to the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her; seen from behind — her head, shoulders, back and hips all face away from the camera in one line, no twist at the waist; her face and chest are not shown, and any skin the outfit reveals shows only from behind (shoulders, open back, the backs of her legs).
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — on the image's right side, since her back is to the camera; one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament, the object held close against her side, not pushed toward the camera.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side — on the image's left side, since her back is to the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she carries a brass-bound memory glass that keeps a captured image by its grip at her side; it is all she holds.
LEGS: mid-stride, one heel lifting.
GAZE: she looks toward the far distance.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a short gold sword in its sheath — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles, sunglasses, bucket hat, beanie, sun visor, acetate.
